description: Retrieve the most recently created asynchronous job (optionally filtered by plugin, action, or status). Useful for polling/monitoring long-running async work when you need to provide a user-visible status update (for example, in scheduled check-ins) and no explicit completion signal is available.
embedding_description: Get latest async job status. Poll job queue. Monitor long-running jobs. Check whether an async task is pending/processing/completed/failed. Useful for scheduled check-ins and progress updates when waiting on background work.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Asynchronous job record containing: job_id (unique identifier), plugin_name (originating plugin), action_name (triggering action), status (pending/processing/completed/failed/cancelled), created_at/updated_at timestamps, result (success payload), error (failure details)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieves the most recent asynchronous job record, optionally filtered by plugin name, action name, or status
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: No jobs match the specified filters (plugin/action/status). DatabaseError: Job table query failed - possible connection or schema issue. ValidationError: Invalid status value provided (must be pending/processing/completed/failed/cancelled).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For NotFoundError: Verify filter values or try without filters to see all jobs. For DatabaseError: Check database connectivity and job service health. For ValidationError: Use valid status values: pending, processing, completed, failed, cancelled.
